name: Escape Pirate Cove ☠️
desc:
☠️ Ahoy! Welcome to Escape Pirate Cove, matey ☠️

🏴‍☠️ Escape the pirate Cove,
⚓ Use tools to avoid enemies and traverse the island,
🦜 Compete against other players on the leaderboards,

Race against time through dangerous obstacles, outsmart the Pirate King and his crew, discover hidden secrets in this thrilling adventure! 
Will you find a way to escape or find yourself sinking to the depths of Davy Jones’ Locker?
